Class CreateMapController

java.lang.Object
pt.ipp.isep.dei.controller.CreateMapController
public class CreateMapController extends Object
Controller responsible for managing map creation and validation. Provides methods to validate map dimensions, check map name availability, and create new maps in the repository.
